text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated streaming backlog and token-latency in us-west-2. Conditions: streaming_inflight > 600 for 6m AND token_gen_95 > 2200ms. Paging #incidents + oncall.

Eli M (oncall-sre): Taking triage. Seeing a steady climb in active streaming connections and CPU hot threads on runtime-pool-usw2. Tagging runtime and product. @Harper can you pull node metrics?

Harper T (runtime): Looking. runtime-pool-usw2 pods are holding large KV caches from long-lived streams. We also rolled a kernel optimization (kernel-sched-v3) earlier this week which increased micro-batching; could be interacting badly with long sessions.

Zoe Y (prod): Customer impact? Any paid customers timed out or seeing errors?

Lucas P (support): Support: OrbitApps (trial) reports repeated disconnects on long streaming jobs. HealthBridge (paid) reports slow token arrival but still receiving responses. No P0s yet but customers are anxious.

Eli M (oncall-sre): Immediate options: 1) region-wide streaming disable (hard stop), 2) reduce streaming session duration at edge (short TTL), 3) selectively block streaming for non-paid cohorts, 4) enforce stricter per-connection token rate. I want to avoid a hard stop if possible. Propose: shorten session TTL + selectively flip streaming off for trial/free groups in us-west-2, plus per-conn cap. Approve?

Harper T (runtime): Agreed. I can: A) set SESSION_TIMEOUT to 45s on runtime-pool-usw2, B) call control-plane to flip flag for group:trial and group:free in region us-west-2 to force buffered responses, C) push per-connection token limiter at edge. Each step is quick.

Eli M (oncall-sre): Go for it. Make sure paid/enterprise tenants are whitelisted before the flip. Also add a debug header so we can trace downgraded requests (X-Stream-Mode:buffered).

Harper T (runtime): Executing now.

# runtime change: shorten idle timeout for us-west-2
kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/runtime-pool-usw2 SESSION_TIMEOUT_SEC=45

# control-plane: force buffered responses for non-paid cohorts
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/flags
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -d '{"flag":"force_buffered_responses","region":"us-west-2","target":["group:trial","group:free"],"value":true}'

# edge: per-conn token limiter (per-ip=6, per-tenant=4)
traffic change queued: rl-213987-a

deploy-bot: runtime env change rollout started (change-id: env-213987-usw2-ttl).

ops-bot: control-plane: flag ff-213987-a applied and propagated to control-plane workers (10/10).

edge-bot: rate-limit rl-213987-a enforced on 12/12 edge nodes in us-west-2.

Harper T (runtime): Runtime pods updated: 16/16 pods now running SESSION_TIMEOUT_SEC=45. Memory and open handles starting to drop.

Eli M (oncall-sre): Monitoring: active streams dropping 740 -> 190, 95th token latency down 2.4s -> 1.0s, error-rate at edge decreasing. Early signs good.

Lucas P (support): CS: notifying affected customers. Draft message for trial/free customers: 
"Hi — we're temporarily serving streaming content as buffered responses for trial/free accounts in the US-West region to stabilize performance. Paid accounts are prioritized and shouldn't see a change. No action required on your side. We'll update when streaming is restored."

Zoe Y (prod): Please post a brief status update on the status page and avoid promising timelines. I'll prep a postmortem owner assignment.

Harper T (runtime): Note: I found ~8 paid sessions using an old client version that didn't include tenant-id headers; they were briefly downgraded. I've patched the control-plane rule to infer tenant from token metadata before trusting headers. Rolling that now.

ops-bot: control-plane rule update ff-213987-tenant-detect deployed 6/6.

Harper T (runtime): Paid sessions restored. HealthBridge confirms improved token velocity. OrbitApps (trial) now on buffered responses and reconnects succeed.

Eli M (oncall-sre): Good. Next steps: keep mitigations for 30m and then run a 10% gradual re-enable for trial group to verify stability. Also collect logs for downgraded requests (header X-Stream-Mode:buffered).

Harper T (runtime): Follow-ups I'll own: revert kernel-sched-v3 on a canary host if instability recurs; implement an eviction for idle stream state; add per-tenant KV-cache metric. I'll open PRs and link them.

Lucas P (support): Customers updated. HealthBridge happy for now; OrbitApps ok with buffered mode. Escalate if paid impact appears.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (shortened session timeout + non-paid cohorts forced to buffered responses + edge rate limits). Severity: mitigated. Monitoring until 2139881400.

Eli M (oncall-sre): Handing to Harper for monitoring soak. If paid customers regress, page me immediately. Creating postmortem ticket and assigning to Zoe + Harper. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
